description: New drawing from region on a circular record: a span whose start is after its end crosses the origin and is drawn as one window across it (D-34). The Web (gbdraw/web/js/services/region-axis.js sourceSpanOf, read by gbdraw/web/js/app/region-select.js) turns a dragged display span into a source span and says "crosses the origin" when wrapsOrigin is true; Python (gbdraw/api/region_drawing.py _resolve_regions) draws the same source span as one window across the origin. Each case gives the axis source map Python writes for the 16,569 bp record of tests/test_inputs/HmmtDNA.gbk (anchorBase is the display start, step -1 a reverse-complemented record), a display span (start index, length in bases), the source span the Web gives for it, and Python's outcome for that source span: withinRecord (a window inside the record, or the whole record), or acrossOrigin (one window across the origin). Read by tests/web/region-axis.test.mjs and tests/test_region_drawing.py.

cases.name: a whole turn of a rotated record is the whole record, 1 to its length
one base short of a whole turn of a rotated record crosses the origin
a reverse-complemented record: a span that does not cross the origin
a reverse-complemented record: a span across the origin
a rotated record: a span away from 12 o'clock that crosses the origin
a rotated record: a span across 12 o'clock that does not cross the origin
